Care & Cleaning

Glass mouthpieces are easier to maintain than silicone or plastic because they don't absorb residue at a molecular level. After each session, a quick hot-water rinse removes most loose buildup. For a full clean, a 15-minute soak in 91% or higher isopropyl alcohol followed by a warm-water rinse returns the piece to clear. Dry the mouthpiece fully before reattaching — any water in the bore creates visible vapor condensation and can, over time, contribute to mineral deposit buildup around the Dragon Egg's upper port.

Direct Draw vs. Whip vs. Balloon

Primarily, there are three types of transfer methods: direct draw, whip, and balloon.

Direct Draw is the simplest method and is commonly found in portable vaporizers and vape pens. This method involves inhaling the vapor directly from the device's mouthpiece.

On the other hand, the Whip method uses a tube, also known as a whip, to draw the vapor from the device to your mouth. Desktop vaporizers often use this method. The whip offers a cooler, smoother vapor, as the longer pathway allows the vapor to cool before reaching your lungs.

Lastly, the Balloon or bag method is a unique transfer system where the vapor fills a balloon attached to the device. Once the balloon is filled, you can inhale the vapor at your leisure. This method is typically found in high-end desktop vaporizers and is ideal for group sessions as the balloon can be passed around.
